# Cyber Library Contributor License Agreement

Version 1.0, 10 October 2026

Thank you for contributing to the Cyber Library. This agreement explains what rights you give CC CYBER COURSES, the company that publishes the Cyber Library, when you contribute, and what you keep. It exists so that the library can be published, translated, kept online and reused in the company's products, including commercial ones, without asking every contributor again.

You agree to it by writing "I have read and agree to the Cyber Library Contributor License Agreement" in a comment on your first pull request. A bot records that comment.

"We" or "the Company" means CC CYBER COURSES, a French société par actions simplifiée (SIREN 919 933 184), 12 rue de Port-Mahon, 75002 Paris, France, publisher of the Cyber Library and of www.cyberlibrary.com.

"Contribution" means any text, translation, code, image or other material that you intentionally submit to the Cyber Library repositories, for example in a pull request, issue or review comment.

## 9. Changes

The Company may publish new versions of this agreement. A new version applies only to contributions made after its publication.
